opportunities.idea: Segment the uploaded portfolio immediately after ingestion.
opportunities.mechanism: Use portfolio attributes to form actionable clusters before recovery actions are chosen.
opportunities.potential_value: Different treatments can be tested by segment instead of applying one generic recovery flow.
opportunities.experiment: Run the same uploaded sample through baseline handling versus three governed segments and compare recovery proxy metrics.

opportunities.idea: Turn intelligence depth into Basic, Pro and Premium B2B tiers.
opportunities.mechanism: Monetize progressively richer analysis rather than charging only for the upload function.
opportunities.potential_value: Creates a product ladder and clearer upgrade path for B2B clients.
opportunities.experiment: Prototype tier packaging with five target clients and measure preference and willingness to pay.

opportunities.idea: Learn which portfolio attributes and treatments correlate with better recovery outcomes.
opportunities.mechanism: Reuse historical upload and outcome data to improve future recommendations.
opportunities.potential_value: Transforms repeated portfolio loads into compounding decision intelligence.
opportunities.experiment: Backtest simple treatment recommendations on historical labeled outcomes before any live automation.

opportunities.idea: Evolve the upload entry point into a recovery-strategy simulator before execution.
opportunities.mechanism: Generate and compare alternative treatment policies on the same portfolio before a client commits operationally.
opportunities.potential_value: Changes the product from data ingestion into a pre-execution decision system.
opportunities.experiment: Build an offline sandbox that scores several treatment policies against historical outcomes and records uncertainty.
